back.es: Tonight I'm going to a party.
back.example: Tonight I'm going to a party. Are you coming with me?

note: Learners may say "Voy a una fiesta esta noche" or "Esta noche voy a ir a una fiesta", which are also correct, so the self-rating should accept them, and "hoy en la noche" is a common Latin American alternative to "esta noche".
